en: A black‑and‑white historic view over a European riverside city. In the foreground is a large statue of an armored knight with a plumed helmet, standing on a richly decorated stone pedestal and holding a sword. Two children sit on the base of the monument while a uniformed man stands nearby. Curved stone balustrades frame the terrace. In the background, across a wide river, are church towers with baroque spires and dense urban buildings fading into the distance. The image has damage or overexposed areas in the sky and no visible printed caption.
